# picocalc-shell

`picocalc_shell.h` is copied **verbatim** from `include/picocalc_shell.h` in
<https://github.com/BlairLeduc/picocalc-shell> at commit
`f9b53598d6bf7a2d91bfedb8b3fff916bd6bac02`. `drivers/filesystem.c` uses it to
date files with the time the shell keeps.
